Java® Platform, Standard Edition & Java Development Kit
Version 11 API Specification

本文件分为两个部分：

Java SE
The Java Platform, Standard Edition (Java SE) APIs define the core Java platform for general-purpose computing. These APIs are located in names beginning withjavaIn the module at the beginning.
JDK
Java Development Kit (JDK) APIs are specific to the JDK and do not necessarily apply to all implementations of the Java SE Platform. These APIs are located in names beginning withjdkIn the module at the beginning.

Module Description
java.base
Defines the foundational API of the Java SE platform.
java.compiler
Defines language models, annotation processing, and Java compiler APIs.
java.datatransfer
Define APIs for transferring data between and within applications.
java.desktop
Defines the AWT and Swing user interface toolkits, as well as APIs for accessibility, audio, imaging, printing, and JavaBeans.
java.instrument
Defines services that allow agent programs to detect programs running on the JVM.
java.logging
Defines the Java Logging API.
java.management
Defines the Java Management Extensions (JMX) API.
java.management.rmi
Defines the Java Management Extensions (JMX) Remote API. RMI connector 。
java.naming
Defines the Java Naming and Directory Interface (JNDI) API.

java.prefs
Defines the Preferences API.
java.rmi
Define the Remote Method Invocation (RMI) API.
java.scripting

java.se
Define the API for the Java SE platform.
java.security.jgss
Defines Java bindings for the IETF Generic Security Services API (GSS-API).
java.security.sasl
Defines Java support for the IETF Simple Authentication and Security Layer (SASL).
java.smartcardio
Defines the Java Smart Card I/O API.
